note: ONE WAVE-CLOCKED PLAN AT THE GATE, then HOLD. Wave triggers, not gold triggers, on purpose: a gold trigger can only be served where the purse rises, i.e. standing on a live seam, and the seams here hold 30 gold (six 5-gold ticks, ~9s) before they go dark — so a gold-triggered cell is a moving target. A wave trigger is a clock the reflex layer can walk to. Every cell sits within ~1-3.6wu of an authored seam site AND at |z|>=7, off the river band (Terrain refuses -5<=z<=5), so the hero is inside the 6wu placement circle while it is still earning. Spacing: one build every two waves, so no two orders come due on the same tick and the purse always clears the price (turret ladder 50/70/95/125 against ~1.5 gold/s). The two HARVESTs name LIVE node ids, not the stablePrefix anchor ids, because those two lists disagree from the first frame (prefix says gold-seam-1 is at -22,-6.8; the live node called gold-seam-1 is at -9,6.7). REPAIR_UNDER sits last because any order that returns a movement every tick starves everything behind it.
